head_south.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: FRONT/south isolated head texture for a low-resolution RimWorld pawn.
Image 1 is the existing Vertin v5 HEAD to edit. Image 2 is a SAME-PIXEL-SCALE comparison: its FIRST column is the current overly long face to FIX; the Texas, Zima and Silence columns show the desired compact rounder face dimensions and simple game-texture treatment. Images 3 and 4 are Texas and Zima source sprites as style/proportion references ONLY. Do not borrow their hair, ears, colors or identity.
Change Vertin's FACE SHAPE, FACIAL MARKS and jaw outline to match the compact small pawn faces in those references:
- Shorten the face below the eyes by about 20-25 percent. Raise the bottom of the chin visibly; keep the eye line near its existing height. Keep cheek width close to existing, optionally slightly fuller at the lower cheek transition. Replace the elongated sharp V lower jaw with a short softly rounded U/rounded trapezoid taper and a blunt little chin. No pointed anime-model chin, long diagonal jaw slopes, realistic cheekbones or broad baby cheeks.
- Exposed forehead/skin should not read as a tall portrait face: slightly lower the visible hairline where necessary while retaining the distinct deep asymmetrical side part. Keep the head's outer hat/skull size stable; change the face within it, do not scale the entire head.
- Use ONE flat pale warm skin color with at most a tiny subdued ear/under-hair shade. No cheek gradients, blush, facial lighting, nose plane or nose highlight.
- Keep Vertin's calm neutral grey-green gaze. Make each eye a clear small dark upper stroke and simple grey-green iris shape, slightly fuller vertically only if needed for small-scale readability. Not giant sparkling chibi eyes. Delete doubled eyelid/eyebrow wrinkles, tiny eyelashes, layered iris facets and tiny under-lip marks. One short brow each; nose is at most a tiny subdued dot/tick or omitted; mouth is one short quiet dark dash.
- Cheek/jaw contour must be a continuous confident near-black stroke, visibly comparable to the Texas/Zima outlines (about 2.5-3 native pixels when this head is normalized to a 256px canvas); inner facial marks subordinate. Hand-drawn small sprite clarity, no polished vector-portrait finesse, no fine texture. Favor a few flat broad shapes that survive being displayed very small; do not over-refine. Not an artificial giant block-pixel mosaic.
Preserve Vertin's established hairstyle: ash-silver grey-green deep side part, the LONG front lock on IMAGE LEFT, ONE LOW coiled hair bun also on IMAGE LEFT behind that lock, small curved near-ear wisp at IMAGE RIGHT. Keep the plum hat, blue-grey band, bow and two dark-tipped ribbons on IMAGE RIGHT, same size/tilt/placement. Preserve the compact 2-3-shade hair and thick hair/hat outer edges. Do not add hair strands, decorations or extra bun. Do not change costume or add a neck/body.
Keep upright straight-on FRONT view, no tilt/rotation. Complete isolated head and hat with original transparent padding, true alpha. No text, reference grid, panel, checkerboard, background or shadows.

head_east.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: EAST/right-facing isolated head texture for a low-resolution RimWorld pawn.
Input 1 is Vertin's current v5 EAST HEAD to edit. Input 2 is the newly revised FRONT head: use its compact rounded face proportions, simple eyes and flat skin as the SAME character. Input 3 is the same-pixel-scale reference comparison, whose FIRST column is the old overly long face being corrected; the Texas and Zima columns show desired small compact pawn faces. Inputs 4 and 5 are east sprites of Texas and Zima for small-scale rendering/style only.
Edit the FACE, EAR and jaw contour of input 1. Preserve the right-facing true profile and completely UPRIGHT head. Compact the exposed face: shorten eye-to-chin distance approximately 20-25%, reduce the long face area between ear and nose by roughly 10-15%, and replace the long slanted pointed jaw with a short rounded/blunt jaw ending. Nose becomes a small unobtrusive contour bump instead of a long angular wedge. Cheek and chin form a compact softly rounded game-pawn silhouette similar to Texas/Zima, no projecting square mandible or long anatomical face. Do not make a baby face or change the head into three-quarter view.
Simplify the visible ear: smaller tidy skin wedge/oval tucked under hair with at most ONE internal stroke; remove large anatomical inner-ear curls and the long dangling skin shape below it. Keep the lower skull connection sensible for the existing body.
Match the revised front image's calm half-lidded grey-green eye and small simple marks. One dark upper eye stroke, simple grey-green iris, minimal highlight, one short eyebrow if visible, single tiny mouth dash, no lip details or nose plane. Flat pale warm skin, at most a small ear shade; no skin gradients or shine.
Strong near-black cheek/jaw silhouette about 2.5-3 native px when normalized to a 256px PNG, comparable to Texas/Zima. Interior marks lighter/simpler. This must read as a coarse small game sprite with broad flat colors and modest antialiasing; no high-definition illustration detail, glossy portrait polish, microtextures, tiny eyelashes or thin ornamental lines. No artificial giant block-pixel mosaic.
Preserve the existing ash-silver grey-green hairstyle, compact rear hair, deep side part, face-framing strand, and small partly occluded FAR-SIDE bun at the rear/LEFT of the picture. The same single bun is physically on character right: don't move it to the near temple, add another bun or add a ponytail. Keep plum hat and blue-grey band/bow/two dark-tipped tails at their original size/tilt/placement. Do not shrink or move the entire head to fake a smaller face; edit the face inside the established hat/hair silhouette. No extra hair detail.
Head only, no neck/body/collar. Entire head and hat with transparent padding and true alpha. No text, labels, panel, checkerboard, backdrop, shadow or additional views.
